desc: bracing, a structural member used to stiffen a framework
puffball, any of various fungi of the genus Scleroderma having hard-skinned subterranean fruiting bodies resembling truffles
tree, a tall perennial woody plant having a main trunk and branches forming a distinct elevated crown; includes both gymnosperms and angiosperms
fortress, a fortified defensive structure
foodstuff, a substance that can be used or prepared for use as food
tyrant flycatcher, large American birds that characteristically catch insects on the wing
hickory tree, American hardwood tree bearing edible nuts
sea turtle, any of various large turtles with limbs modified into flippers; widely distributed in warm seas
fare, the food and drink that are regularly served or consumed
fruit, the ripened reproductive body of a seed plant
gourd vine, any vine of the family Cucurbitaceae that bears fruits with hard rinds
container, any object that can be used to hold things (especially a large metal boxlike object of standardized dimensions that can be loaded from one form of transport to another)
nutritionist, a specialist in the study of nutrition
vessel, an object used as a container (especially for liquids)
soul, a human being; "there was too much for one person to do"
quiver, shake with fast, tremulous movements; "His nostrils palpitated"
constructor, someone who contracts for and supervises construction (as of a building)
shelf, a support that consists of a horizontal surface for holding objects
goal, game equipment consisting of the place toward which players of a game try to advance a ball or puck in order to score points
migrator, traveler who moves from one region or country to another
mustard, any of several cruciferous plants of the genus Brassica
